style: Style: Japanese mingei woodblock print, flat areas of color with a limited palette of about five colors, bold simple shapes, visible soft paper grain, warm and friendly, consistent with a hand-printed folk craft. It must print well on an office laser printer. Absolutely no text, no letters, no kanji, no numbers, no logos, no signature, no seal stamp, no border, no frame. No people. Fill the whole square edge to edge; keep the main subject in the center with generous space around it.

art.kani/right: one small female snow crab holding bright orange roe under her body, on a soft blue-grey background

art.kani/left: one plump deep-sea eelpout fish with a big soft head and a friendly expression, on a dark teal background
